svg.title: Figure 1. The three test set-ups
svg.desc: Three schematic panels. (a) Part A: the 25.4 by 50.8 millimeter aluminum bar on supports 400 millimeters apart with a central load P; a plus-and-minus 45 degree gage pair sits at mid-height on the face, 100 millimeters from the left support. Small insets show the bar upright and flat, with the gage pairs at the middle of the two side faces in each orientation. (b) Part B: an aluminum I-beam with a central load over spans from 300 to 1200 millimeters; gage pairs on the web at three heights, and a displacement transducer on a yoke that spans the supports and reads the midspan deflection of the bottom flange. (c) Part C: two 50.8 by 12.7 millimeter bars stacked, over a 600 millimeter span with a central load, tested loose, joined by six bolts, and bonded; a dial gage at the left end reads the slip between the bars.
